title: Future Careers
subtitle: 本課限定語境：future careers = careers and occupations likely to grow, develop, or become more im
description: 本課限定語境：future careers = careers and occupations likely to grow, develop, or become more important in the future · 「未來職業／未來發展中的工作」

words.note: 較形象、宣傳式地表示未來可能重要或普及的工作。
words.example: Schools are preparing students for the jobs of tomorrow.
words.exampleZh: 學校正為學生準備迎接未來的工作。

exercises.original: Schools are preparing students for future careers in technology and healthcare.
exercises.zh: 學校正為學生準備迎接科技和醫療領域的未來職業。
exercises.upgrade: Schools are preparing students for the jobs of tomorrow.

options.explanation: 教育和未來工作語境中自然，而且帶展望未來的語氣。
指目前職位空缺，不是未來職業。

exercises.original: The exhibition introduces teenagers to future careers shaped by new technology.
exercises.zh: 展覽向青少年介紹由新科技塑造的未來職業。
exercises.upgrade: The exhibition introduces teenagers to the jobs of tomorrow.

options.explanation: 也很接近，但更正式、報告式。
青少年教育展覽特別適合這種較生動的說法。
表示例行工作，不等於未來職業。
是產業，不是具體工作角色。
缺少固定結構中的 of。

exercises.original: Career advisers discussed the skills needed for future careers.
exercises.zh: 職涯顧問討論未來工作所需的技能。
exercises.upgrade: Career advisers discussed the skills needed for the jobs of tomorrow.

options.explanation: 自然地把重點放在未來工作所需能力。

words.note: 表示正在出現、擴張或逐漸形成的職業。
words.example: The report identifies several emerging occupations in renewable energy.
words.exampleZh: 報告指出可再生能源領域有數個新興職業。

exercises.original: The labour-market report lists several future careers that are only beginning to develop.
exercises.zh: 勞動市場報告列出數個才剛開始發展的新興職業。
exercises.upgrade: The labour-market report lists several emerging occupations.

options.explanation: 也可，但只表示新，不一定強調正處於形成階段。
正式勞動市場報告 + 正在形成，是最精確。

exercises.original: Researchers are tracking future careers created by advances in biotechnology.
exercises.zh: 研究人員正追蹤因生物科技進步而出現的新興職業。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers are tracking emerging occupations created by advances in biotechnology.

options.explanation: 新技術催生的新職業最自然。
是職缺／機會，不是職業類別。
是已成熟、已建立的專業。

exercises.original: Policy makers want better data on future careers that are appearing in the green economy.
exercises.zh: 政策制定者希望取得更多關於綠色經濟中新興職業的數據。
exercises.upgrade: Policy makers want better data on emerging occupations in the green economy.

options.explanation: 語義接近，但政策數據語境較不正式。
不是勞動市場職業類別。
可作抽象研究概念，但不指那些職業本身。

words.note: 最直接、簡潔地表示未來可能存在或增長的工作。
words.example: Students are curious about future jobs in artificial intelligence.
words.exampleZh: 學生對人工智能領域的未來工作感到好奇。

exercises.original: Students want to know which future careers will use artificial intelligence.
exercises.zh: 學生想知道哪些未來工作會使用人工智能。
exercises.upgrade: Students want to know which future jobs will use artificial intelligence.

options.explanation: 簡單直接，特別適合學生詢問具體工作。
futurist 指未來學家，不是「未來的」。

exercises.original: The course looks at future careers that may become common over the next decade.
exercises.zh: 課程探討未來十年可能變得普遍的工作。
exercises.upgrade: The course looks at future jobs that may become common over the next decade.

options.explanation: 最直接表達「未來可能普及的工作」。
如果有就業增長證據會更精確，但原句只說 may become common。

exercises.original: Many parents are curious about future careers for their children.
exercises.zh: 很多家長都好奇子女未來可能從事哪些工作。
exercises.upgrade: Many parents are curious about future jobs for their children.

options.explanation: 自然地表示將來可能從事的工作類型。

words.note: 和 future careers 非常接近，常用於教育和職涯規劃。
words.example: The seminar explored careers of the future in healthcare and technology.
words.exampleZh: 講座探討醫療和科技領域的未來職業。

exercises.original: The seminar explored future careers in healthcare, energy, and technology.
exercises.zh: 講座探討醫療、能源和科技領域的未來職業。
exercises.upgrade: The seminar explored careers of the future in healthcare, energy, and technology.

options.explanation: 和 future careers 幾乎完全等值，且自然。
futuristic 常表示看起來很科幻，不等於真實未來職業。

exercises.original: The book introduces young readers to future careers in science.
exercises.zh: 這本書向年輕讀者介紹科學領域的未來職業。
exercises.upgrade: The book introduces young readers to careers of the future in science.

options.explanation: 也接近，但強調正在形成。
教育出版語境非常自然。

exercises.original: Universities are redesigning courses around future careers.
exercises.zh: 大學正圍繞未來職業重新設計課程。
exercises.upgrade: Universities are redesigning courses around careers of the future.

options.explanation: 課程設計配合未來職業需求，完全自然。
個人夢想，不是勞動市場概念。

words.meaning: 新興職涯；正在形成的職業方向
words.note: 表示新的職涯路徑或職業類別正在出現。
words.example: Many emerging careers combine technology with traditional industries.
words.exampleZh: 許多新興職涯把科技和傳統行業結合起來。

exercises.original: Many future careers combine digital technology with traditional professions.
exercises.zh: 許多新興職涯把數碼科技和傳統專業結合起來。
exercises.upgrade: Many emerging careers combine digital technology with traditional professions.

options.explanation: 強調新的職涯路徑正在形成。
意思相反，表示成熟既有職涯。
是抽象「職涯出現」概念，不指具體職涯。

exercises.original: Students were introduced to future careers in drone technology and virtual production.
exercises.zh: 學生獲介紹無人機科技和虛擬製作的新興職涯。
exercises.upgrade: Students were introduced to emerging careers in drone technology and virtual production.

options.explanation: 新興領域中的職涯路徑最貼切。

exercises.original: The website profiles future careers that did not exist in the same form ten years ago.
exercises.zh: 網站介紹十年前尚未以相同形式存在的新興職涯。
exercises.upgrade: The website profiles emerging careers that did not exist in the same form ten years ago.

options.explanation: 時間上新、仍在形成，非常符合。

words.note: 表示相對新近出現的職業類別。
words.example: New occupations are appearing as digital services expand.
words.exampleZh: 隨著數碼服務擴張，新職業正在出現。

exercises.original: Automation has created several future careers that did not previously exist.
exercises.zh: 自動化創造了數個以前不存在的新職業。
exercises.upgrade: Automation has created several new occupations.

options.explanation: 可能增長，但不一定是新出現。
題句直接說以前不存在，因此「新職業」最準確。
是空缺／機會，不是職業類別。

exercises.original: The digital economy continues to generate future careers in areas such as platform management.
exercises.zh: 數碼經濟持續創造平台管理等新職業。
exercises.upgrade: The digital economy continues to generate new occupations.

options.explanation: generate + previously uncommon roles 很自然。
也接近，但重點是未來導向，不一定新。

exercises.original: Some future careers may disappear quickly even though they are new.
exercises.zh: 有些新職業即使剛出現，也可能很快消失。
exercises.upgrade: Some new occupations may disappear quickly even though they are new.

options.explanation: 這題強調「新」不等於「有前景」。
通常暗示需求正在增加，與可能很快消失不完全一致。
通常語氣較正面、前景導向。

words.meaning: 新一代工作；下一代職位
words.note: 較宣傳式，表示和新科技、新產業或新工作方式相關的職位。
words.example: Training programs are being redesigned for next-generation jobs.
words.exampleZh: 培訓課程正重新設計，以配合新一代工作。

exercises.original: The training center is preparing workers for future careers in robotics and advanced manufacturing.
exercises.zh: 培訓中心正為工人準備機械人和先進製造業的新一代工作。
exercises.upgrade: The training center is preparing workers for next-generation jobs.

options.explanation: 新科技＋培訓語境很適合這種創新導向表達。

exercises.original: The initiative focuses on future careers created by automation and smart infrastructure.
exercises.zh: 計劃聚焦由自動化和智能基建帶來的新一代工作。
exercises.upgrade: The initiative focuses on next-generation jobs.

options.explanation: 科技驅動的新工作模式最合適。

exercises.original: Students attended workshops on future careers linked to new digital systems.
exercises.zh: 學生參加有關新數碼系統相關新一代工作的工作坊。
exercises.upgrade: Students attended workshops on next-generation jobs linked to new digital systems.

options.explanation: 新數碼系統帶出的工作很符合此宣傳式用語。

words.meaning: 增長中的職業；需求上升的職業
words.note: 表示就業需求或職位數量預計增長的職業。
words.exampleZh: 醫療領域包括多個快速增長的職業。

exercises.original: Nursing and home-care roles are future careers expected to add many jobs.
exercises.zh: 護理和家居照護是預計會增加大量職位的增長型職業。
exercises.upgrade: Nursing and home-care roles are growth occupations.

options.explanation: 這些職業不一定是新興的。
重點是未來職位數量增加，而不是職業本身新。
不準確，護理並非新職業。
可泛指未來重要工作，但不如 growth 精確。

exercises.original: The report highlights future careers with rapidly rising employment demand.
exercises.zh: 報告重點介紹就業需求快速上升的增長型職業。
exercises.upgrade: The report highlights growth occupations with rapidly rising employment demand.

options.explanation: rising employment demand 是決定性線索。
不是此概念的自然說法。

exercises.original: Some future careers are long-established jobs that are now expanding quickly.
exercises.zh: 有些未來職業其實存在已久，只是現在快速增長。
exercises.upgrade: Some growth occupations are long-established jobs that are now expanding quickly.

options.explanation: 正好說明 growth 不等於 new。
通常暗示正在形成／新興。
帶科幻／前衛語氣，不是就業增長概念。
是抽象增長現象，不指那些職業本身。

words.meaning: 面向未來的職業；具未來導向的職涯
words.note: 表示與未來趨勢、科技或社會需求密切相關的職業。
words.example: The program introduces students to future-facing careers in clean technology.
words.exampleZh: 該課程向學生介紹潔淨科技中的未來導向職業。

exercises.original: The university promotes future careers connected with sustainability and digital transformation.
exercises.zh: 大學推廣與可持續發展和數碼轉型相關的未來導向職業。
exercises.upgrade: The university promotes future-facing careers connected with sustainability and digital transformation.

options.explanation: 與重大未來趨勢直接相連，最自然。

exercises.original: Students are encouraged to explore future careers that align with long-term technological change.
exercises.zh: 學生獲鼓勵探索與長期科技轉變一致的未來導向職涯。
exercises.upgrade: Students are encouraged to explore future-facing careers.

options.explanation: 也接近，但不一定所有相關職涯都正在新出現。
重點是與 long-term technological change 對齊。

exercises.original: The program focuses on future careers that are likely to remain relevant as society changes.
exercises.zh: 課程聚焦在社會變化中仍可能保持重要性的未來導向職業。
exercises.upgrade: The program focuses on future-facing careers.

options.explanation: 重點是面向未來變化並保持相關性。
新職業不一定長期重要。

words.note: 表示某些職業領域仍在形成、擴張或改變中。
words.example: Cybersecurity is one of several rapidly developing career fields.
words.exampleZh: 網絡安全是多個快速發展的職業領域之一。

exercises.original: Students are exploring future careers in areas that are still evolving rapidly.
exercises.zh: 學生正在探索仍快速演變中的職業領域。
exercises.upgrade: Students are exploring developing career fields.

options.explanation: areas that are still evolving rapidly 直接指整個職業領域正在發展。
是成熟產業，而且不是 career field。
career 作定語通常用單數。

exercises.original: The college created new courses for future careers in rapidly changing sectors.
exercises.zh: 學院為快速變化行業中的新興職業領域開設新課程。
exercises.upgrade: The college created new courses for developing career fields.

options.explanation: 課程設計通常對應較廣的職業領域。

exercises.original: Advisers discussed future careers in fields that are expanding and changing at the same time.
exercises.zh: 顧問討論那些一邊擴張、一邊變化中的職業領域。
exercises.upgrade: Advisers discussed developing career fields.

options.explanation: 同時「擴張＋演變」最符合 developing fields。
強調就業數量增長，不一定整個領域都在重塑。
可能成熟穩定，不符合題意。

falseSynonyms.zh: 夢想工作 ≠ 未來職業 dream job 指個人最想做的工作，不表示它是新興或未來需求高的職業。
職涯目標 ≠ 未來職業 career goals 是個人想達成的職涯目標。
工作機會 ≠ 未來職業 job opportunities 指目前或某時間存在的職位空缺／就業機會。
就業趨勢 ≠ 職業本身 employment trends 描述變化趨勢，不是某一類工作。
未來技能 ≠ 未來職業 skills of the future 是技能，例如 data literacy、AI literacy、communication。
未來產業 ≠ 未來職業 industry 是產業；career / occupation 是人的工作角色。
概念層次不同 - job = 一份具體工作／職位 - occupation = 職業類別 - career = 長期職涯路徑
詞義接近但搭配不同 - emerging occupation = 正在出現的新興職業 - emergent = 較學術，表示逐漸形成、由系統產生 一般職涯語境優先用 emerging。
